text.headline: Hebrew reading, one belt at a time.
text.lede: Play the games in a stripe to earn a star. Get 3 stars to move up a belt.
text.beltsSubtitle: Start with White. Work up to Black.

howTo.Matching pairs: Flip two cards. Find the ones that match.
howTo.Match up: Drag each one to its match.
howTo.Group sort: Drag each one into the right group.
howTo.Rank order: Drag them into the right order.
howTo.Balloon pop: Pop the balloon to drop it on its match.
howTo.Flying fruit: Tap the right answer as it flies by.
howTo.Whack-a-mole: Tap the moles with the right answer.
howTo.Open the box: Tap a box. Read what is inside out loud.
howTo.Spin the wheel: Spin the wheel. Read it out loud.
howTo.Speaking cards: Tap to get a card. Read it out loud.
howTo.True or false: Is it right? Tap True or False.
howTo.Gameshow quiz: Tap the right answer. Be quick!
howTo.Win or lose quiz: Pick your points. Then tap the right answer.
howTo.Airplane: Fly into the right answers. Miss the wrong ones.
howTo.Labelled diagram: Drag each word to its spot.
howTo.Anagram: Drag the letters into the right order.
howTo.Watch and memorize: Watch closely. Then pick what you saw.
howTo.Speed sorting: Put each one in the right group. Be quick!
howTo.Flash cards: Say the answer. Then flip the card.
howTo.Complete the sentence: Drag each word into the right blank.
howTo.Categorize: Drag each one into the right group.
